column1: # Lane-private build output defaults (#213), read by _build_dirs.sh for gate-slot.sh and
# heavy-build-slot.sh. MATCH<TAB>KIND<TAB>NAME<TAB>VALUE: MATCH is * or tool names joined by |; KIND
# env exports NAME=VALUE, KIND arg inserts NAME VALUE after the tool word (kept when the command
# already passes NAME). {dir} is the lane build dir, {id} the lane id, {worktree} the worktree.
# A repo replaces this table with <state dir>/<owner>__<repo>/build-dirs.tsv (start from a copy);
# ORCHESTRATE_BUILD_DIRS=off turns it off. See skills/orchestrate/host-load.md.
# Gradle build/ dirs are under the worktree already, so lane-private; a build that writes elsewhere
# can read ORCHESTRATE_LANE_BUILD_DIR (exported to every gate). Not on by default, since it gives up
